podcast.body: The B-side of The Go-Go's single "Our Lips Are Sealed" features an old-school instrumental surf track titled "Surfing and Spying." "If you check out the B side of the Go-Gos, our lips are sealed, you'll find an old school instrumental track called Surfing and Spine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Surprising History of Surf Music

podcast.body: This song was co-written by guitarist Jane Wiedlin and Terry Hall from The Specials and Fun Boy Three. Released in 1981, it blended UK New Wave cool with California pop energy, standing out for its upbeat yet defiant, fun yet professional sound, and was crucial in bringing New Wave to Top 40 radio. "The song was co-written by guitarist Jane Wiedenland and Terry Hall from the specials in Funboy 3."

This song was released from The Go-Go's debut album, *Beauty and the Beat*. It managed to enter the top 20 on the charts, contributing to the album's overall success. "Our lips are sealed from the debut album by the Go Go's Beauty and the Beat. The song snuck into the top 20."
